SpaceLevel.description:
A person's level in an App-governed Space (K2's sync sets it), and an App's
`max_level`. `moderator` and `admin` are the Space's managed roles; `member` is
`@everyone`.

oneOf.description: The managed Admin role (the Moderator bits plus MENTION_EVERYONE).

display_name.description: The App's display name; absent when unset.

hidden_from_home.description: The App's Spaces are left out of the home client.

max_level.description:
The highest level K2's sync may give in the App's governed Spaces. Old
payloads read as `moderator`.

origin.description: The App's signalling origin; absent when unset.

origins.description:
Flag `app_origins`: the App's further web origins, sorted; absent when none
(old payloads read as none).

uploads.description:
Whether the App's people may upload files in its governed Spaces. Old payloads
read as `true`.
